name: 16801 · State College, PA
findings: ZIP 16801 (State College) has 234 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 114 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16801 (State College) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16801 (State College) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
